reviews.text: Lovely vet clinic I have came today for the first time with my cat and I loved the experience Andrew was really good at explaining everything to me as I lacked of knowledge and my cat was very comfortable with him

We’ve been super impressed with the care our cat has received at Wolfe Vets.

During what was meant to be a routine check-up, Dr. Alice suggested further heart diagnostics after picking up on something that could easily have gone unnoticed otherwise. The tests ultimately identified hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and meant we could catch it early and monitor it properly.

Dr. James has also been wonderful, following up several times after the procedure, consulting with cardiology colleagues and taking the time to talk us through the different options and risks in a really thoughtful and reassuring way.

Our cat also had a dental treatment with the team, and especially given his heart diagnosis and the added anaesthetic risk, we felt he was being looked after incredibly carefully.

Dr. Beril was there to support us promptly following the procedure.

A genuinely caring, thorough and thoughtful team. We feel very lucky to have Wolfe Vets as our vet team.

Thank you for your feedback.

We will investigate the issue regarding your direct debit and get back to your personally. If an inappropriate payment has been taken by the direct debit collection agency we will refund it in full.

We have made every effort to be the best we can with regard to our feline friends, and have been recognised for that. I am sorry that your experience did not mirror this.

We are one of only handful of clinics in London that are accredited Gold Standard by the International Cat Care organisation. We are keen to show people the cat facilities and explain what allows us to reach that grade.

With regards to costs: we provide our dental anaesthesia, bloods and descaling package at a discount and a 15% Wolfe Pack dental discount takes the package well below cost price. Our dentistry facilities and staff training is excellent. If you can provide a side by side estimate and details of the location of care I am keen to examine it.

The Wolfe Foundation, our charitable arm, has donated over £3000 to charitable causes in the 2 years up to June 2022. We have a 10% general discount scheme built into the Wolfe Pack and heavily discount the care of critically unwell and injured animals who fit our criteria for such service. We need to charge for our services to be able to operate the level of hospital we do but do also have systems in place to both distribute income to the charities we support and help deserving cases with reduced fees.

Thank you again for your review. Of course I wish it had been positive but I genuinely appreciate the opportunity to respond. We will be in touch directly relating to the issues above.

Yours sincerely,

James Bennett, Owner of Wolfe Vets.

Very pleased with the care my cat received at Wolfe Vets Chiswick. The team was friendly, attentive and helpful throughout. They made the visit as comfortable as possible, and I felt my cat was in good hands. Thank you.
The prices are extortionate even for London (“we are independent”) and the receptionist are rude. Far better vets out there. You’ve been warned!!

We have been going to Wolfe Vets in Chiswick for over a year now and our experience with them in that time has only improved. From the staff on the front desk, (shout out to Shirin, Mel and Katie) for always making us feel welcome and working to accommodate our dogs. On the surgical side I have nothing but great things to say about Dr. Dulcie Howe. She performed two quite tricky surgeries on one of our dogs and did an excellent job! She also has a lovely manner with dogs and humans alike. Recently, the entire team helped us through the saddest time when we had to let our old boy go. I cannot praise them enough for their care and compassion. It will never be forgotten.
Our remaining dog loves the team there so much she regularly detours to the office while out on a walk! Thoroughly recommend.
Thank you for your review!

I find staff friendly and very helpfull
They are very good with my cat Mopsey.

We brought Kenzo, our Australian Labradoodle, to Wolfe Vets with a severe and complex skin disease that had left him in significant discomfort. From our very first appointment, Alice, Dulcie, Fei  and the whole team have shown exceptional expertise, kindness and compassion, supporting not only Kenzo but also us as worried owners.

Kenzo’s journey is still ongoing, but we no longer feel like we’re facing it alone. The team has always been available for appointments and advice, and thanks to their knowledge and support, we have confidence in managing his condition and keeping him comfortable and happy. We couldn’t recommend Wolfe Vets more highly!!

Wolfe vets is the best vet in the area . They are caring, loving and honest when it comes to extra costing. We had two difficult instances with our dog and they promptly acted and helped us! I would never be more grateful to the team for this! Highly recommended :)
Thank you for your review
Wolf Is the best Vet in west london !  We have a happy healthy dog thanks to Wolf Vets.
The doctors, nurses and receptionists are friendly, kind and caring.
Thank you for your review

I cannot recommend Wolfe Vets enough. They always find time to fit us in, and every single member of the staff is lovely, but their care during a recent emergency really showed how incredible they are. My pup became very ill out of nowhere, and they fit us in at the last minute.

When we realised he needed to be hospitalised, Dr. James was amazing—he explained the entire process in detail and was completely transparent about the upfront costs. I was understandably upset, and Shirin showed me so much kindness and comfort when I needed it most. Over the last few days, Dr Rachel has given me regular updates on his progress, completely reassuring me that he’s getting the best possible care. Seeing my pup happily walk off with the nurse during our visit today proved to me just how safe and loved he feels there. Thank you, Wolfe Vets, for your unmatched care and service!
Wolfe Vets have been great to us over the years with our cat. The staff are always welcoming and knowledgeable, and pleasant to interact with. Would highly recommend.

We have two little papillons, Lottie and Lulu, who between them have a number of (different) ongoing issues so we have a lot of visits to Wolfe Vets. In spite of the worry and concern we have about both of them , as soon as we walk in we feel reassured that they will receive the best care. We know that Lottie and Lulu will be seen and treated with the utmost care by the amazing nurses and Dr James and Dr Alice. They fill us with confidence and take a lot of time to explain whatever procedures are required. This will all probably be ongoing but we are so grateful and relieved that they are both under such excellent care with compassionate and professional experts. And we appreciate their patience with us also as two concerned owners! Also worth mentioning is how wonderful Charlotte is in sorting out the pet insurance claims quickly and efficiently. Just one less thing to worry about. And how helpful and
kind all the reception and administration  team are. I mention Melanie, Shirin and Jo Jo in particular because over the years we have been going to Wolfe they have always been so supportive and efficient with sorting out our many appointments and medication requests.

Our dogs have been with James and his team now since he opened the Chiswick practice and both our dogs have had wonderful care from all the team. The follow up of Amber's liver cancer which James diagnosed has been superb. Amber is 15 now and we know that quality of life is central to her care. Frodo's had several operations including major surgery by Dr Alice and Dr James which needed intensive care.  The Wolfe Pack with it's inclusive consultations, regular checkups, open access to specialist nurse and specialist vets at the practice.  The discount on all our medicines and investigations, CT  scans and operations, has been the icing on the cake. Thank you so much all of you at Wolf vets on behalf of Amber, Frodo and their owners.
Just saw the receptionist carry a dog across the road for an elderly lady who was struggling to carry her limping dog. How lovely
Poor customer service for loyal customers. Had me waiting nearly an hour for check up appointments. Did not end up seeing the vet as had to leave - total disregard for our time.
Very personal and caring treatment.   Would heartily recommend.

The Chiswick Wolfe vets is really good. I have thought about swapping to one of the subscription vets but these guys are good. The vaccinations are reasonably priced but the vets are very kind and friendly

I cannot recommend James Bennett and the entire team at Wolfe Vets highly enough. Five years ago, we were faced with the devastating news from multiple vets that our beloved cat should be put down. James refused to accept that as the only option. With his exceptional expertise and genuine dedication, he presented us with alternative treatment paths that other vets simply hadn't considered. We took his advice, and today — five years on — our cat is living a wonderfully happy life. We owe that entirely to James.

We have five cats in total, and Wolfe Vets has been our trusted home for all of them. Every single person on the team, from the warm and welcoming reception staff to the incredibly skilled surgical team, has gone above and beyond for us time and time again. No matter the hour, they have always been there when we needed them.

If you are looking for a vet who genuinely cares, who will fight for your pet when others won't, and who is backed by an outstanding team — look no further than James Bennett at Wolfe Vets.

Thank you James and forever grateful for all your help and support.

Lots of love from Coco, Chanel, Star, Sky and Luna!

Not my real name. I don’t usually write reviews, and this is being written a long time after my experience.

My time at Wolfes was mixed. I believe the clinical staff genuinely care about animals and try to do their best. I always felt they made sound clinical decisions for my pets.

However, since leaving London and registering with a new vet, I’ve had my pets clinical history reviewed. My current vet expressed surprise at the number of tests and procedures that had been carried out, and suggested that some may have been unnecessary or more extensive than expected—particularly certain biopsies and allergy testing.

At the time, I did feel that the level of intervention (and associated costs) was quite high, but I trusted the advice I was given. In hindsight, I wish I had sought a second opinion earlier.

I’m sharing this so that others feel encouraged to ask questions, fully understand the necessity of recommended treatments, and consider a second opinion if something doesn’t feel right. I wish I had.

Looking back, I do have some concern that certain treatments may have caused unnecessary stress or discomfort for my pets, which is difficult to reflect on.

This is just my personal experience.

I wanted to write a review about physiotherapist Cindy lu.
Honestly I have no words for Cindy, she has been so so wonderful to my little boy and me that words can’t do justice
My little boy was diagnosed with a lot of issues recently and I was beyond devastated he is only 6 years old
Cindy is the first and only one who gave us hope and her dedication to us the way she goes above and beyond to look after pepper. She will reach out outside of appointments to check in on him, order me food for him to help him lose weight and the encouragement and happiness she gives us whenever we go is so touching.
I can’t thank you enough Cindy for all that you do for us and if anyone has any issues with their fur babies related to joints/arthiritis/ IVDD - Take a deep breath and please go to Cindy. Believe me you will forget about all the sadness and your little one will start leaping like a puppy again in no time.
Thank you so much aunty Cindy we love you lots
Sehrish and pepper

The team at Wolfe Vets are amazing! James and his team did a great job on putting our cat back together after being run over, we are so grateful for all involved, for the professionalism and empathy we received.

Also a special mention to Cindy the physiotherapist who has a wonderful rapport with our cat and has delivered exceptional service in the weeks following his accident. He has made great progress over the weeks and loves his weekly sessions with Cindy.  Thank you so much!
Very helpful team who helped with a stray cat.
Absolutely one of the best vets I have ever seen! Even the receptionist loves Ralphie!
We have taken our dog to Wolfe vets since we first brought her home as a puppy and the care and support has always been amazing. I absolutely recommend them to everyone!

Money, money, money!! So overpriced and dishonest.

Charged me £200 MORE than the initial quote for my dog’s procedure. Ryanair pricing tactics with “optional” extras! They pressure you to buy stuff you don’t need and hide the real cost.

Only idiots would go back to this place
They saved my cats life!

Everything about this practice is wonderful, starting with the  staff at reception who make you feel welcome  instantly.  I always feel  that the nurses  and vets listen to any concerns  I may have about my animals and they are kind, knowledgeable  and compassionate.  My dogs rush INTO  the vet, they like being there so much!

I cannot recommend Wolfe Vets highly enough for the care they provided my dog, Arnie. Throughout a very difficult few months, the entire team was proactive, thorough, and deeply attentive.

I am especially grateful to Dr. James for his incredible patience, and taking the time to explain every medical scenario and outcome as thoroughly as possible. Having that level of detail helped me feel truly informed and confident during such a stressful time. I also want to thank Dr. Dulcie and Dr. Aimee for their expertise and care during Arnie’s other surgeries. Dr. Dulcie even made a point to check in on us in the waiting room months later just to offer support and reassurance, which meant so much.

They prioritized Arnie’s well-being over everything else, showing a level of kindness that's rarely seen. When it came time to say goodbye during the busy holiday season, Dr. Dulcie went above and beyond by coming to our home so Arnie could be at peace. Her reassurance that we were making the right decision was invaluable. The team also provided us with beautiful, tangible memories of him that I will treasure forever.

A special thank you to Mel and Shirin at the front desk for their constant support and kind words. And to all the nurses working behind the scenes. They truly treated Arnie like family, and I am so grateful for the care and compassion they gave him until the very end.

Excellent care - extremely knowledgeable and caring team with the latest tools and technology.  Experts in all pet care, from the routine checkups to once-in a-pet-lifetime issues and emergencies. Join the Wolfe pack!
Friendly and knowledgable staff. Best of all, our dog actually looks forward to going to the vets 🐶 …
This clinic has the best doctors and the most welcoming and understanding staff. I have bern going with my two cats for 3 years now

We’ve been changing our vets as moving across London. Wolfe vets is definitely the best we’ve ever had. Super friendly staff and professional vets and nurses. Both of my dogs are registered with them and love visiting the clinic so much!
Great staff, always professional and helpful. Excellent practical advice. They have performed wonders on my 16-year-old cat who is still going strong

Impeccable service!!
This is not just your local vets this is people that care!
If you want the best for your furry companion I wouldn’t go anywhere else.
Me and my Son Robin would like to thank the owner
Mr James Bennet for his love and continued care
We both 100% appreciate everything.
If we could give more than 5 star we would
Thank you!!!

You could not find a better vet for your beloved pet.  James looked after my previous cat and has cared for my current feline since he was a 4 month old kitten. This new practice has 'state of the art' facilities and warm, welcoming staff.

My most recent experience at Wolfe Vets (Nov 2025) proved, once again, how excellent James and his team are.  The cause of Alfie's consistent constipation was identified by imaging and he is now on a regime of meds to alleviate the problem.  Also, my insurance claim was processed in just a few days - which was really helpful. Thank you Wolfe Vets!

Very happy to recommend Wolfe vets to anyone. Our dog suffers from an immune disorder and IVDD so we are unfortunately needing more visits to the vets than average!

Our dog recently needed spinal surgery and everything from diagnostics, through surgery to aftercare was excellent.

Being able to get blood test results almost immediately and having a CT scanner in-house was a huge differentiator as it meant we didn't need to drive a poorly dog around London and wait anxiously for results.

We’re deeply grateful to the entire team at Wolfe Vets for their exceptional care, compassion, and professionalism. They make the most difficult parts of being a dog parent so much easier.

Thank you for helping us with both of our cats. Nutella and Ursula. Thank you for being very helpful, tactful and reassuring when we are anxious about their wellbeing. We are so lucky to be your clients!

Great place, really professional but also nice and kind staff. Dr James gave me amazing feedback on my dogs conditions, even things that no one else ever told me or cared about, for sure a place to trust my dogs health.

We have been visiting Wolfe vets since it first opened. James and his team have provided wonderful care for our 5yr old Yochon, Honey. As a puppy Honey was prone to grass seed incidents that required surgery and out of hours emergency care, and Wolfe vets always provided the best care possible. Being part of the Wolfe pack gives us peace of mind as the annual checkups gives us a chance to raise any health concerns and receive guidance on how to care for Honey and aim for longevity. I can’t recommend James and his team enough.

I travel some distance to take my beloved spaniel here. They were recommended by a friend & haven’t disappointed. The vets all seem highly competent and caring, the various options for treatment always clearly explained without any pushiness. I appreciate having my boy under the ongoing care of the same vet, although when she has been away or he needed seeing urgently the other vets have all been equally good.  The Wolfe Pack subscription works really well for me & gives me peace of mind that Rafi is always up-to-date with his vaccinations & flea / worm treatment - and importantly that I will always be able to see a vet, should I need one, at no extra cost. In a sea of dubiousness & large profit driven chains, Wolfe vets have been an island of reasonableness & high quality care! Special mention & thanks  to Dr Alice & Dr Aimee. Adrian & Rafiki

Wolfe Vets in both Chiswick and Fulham were absolutely amazing. The care that our dog received was outstanding and we were so thankful to be in such good hands. She was ill for three weeks, with two overnight stays in Fulham, and I was very grateful that I was never made to feel like a nuisance if I called at any time of day or night. We are extremely grateful to Wolfe Vets for everything they did for us and are so thankful to have our happy, healthy dog back again.

We have been using Wolfe Vets, since it opened, for our dog's care. She has needed some diagnostic work and more than one surgical intervention during that time.
We have complete confidence in James and his team, including those not involved in the medical side of things.
Even though everyone is busy, they take time to fully explore a problem, explain what's happening, and the options for treatment.
Definitely recommend Wolfe Vets.

Super professional & friendly. I had an emergency so needed to call in the middle of the night as my little one was very poorly. The emergency was amazing very clear instructions on what to do, booked me an appointment for that morning. I was seen by the vet & now my little one is slowly recovering. all the vets are great & very friendly & helpful team.

Wolfe Vets are a wonderful, caring, competent vets. My border terrier loves going there and all the team are delightful and give you their full attention, answer questions etc. without rushing you. I would highly recommend them.

Wolfe Vets have been the best practice I have experienced. My cat is 18 years old with kidney failure and starting a chest tumor. Dr James and his team have literary saved my cat’s life by prescribing the right treatment and medicines at this crucial time. They are very careful and supportive. Follow ups are very  smooth and professional. Highly recommended

This is one of the best vets I've ever seen with my dog. They provide professional and loving care for my pet. I can always count on them, especially when I need emergency care. I recommend Wolfe Vets, where they will take excellent care of your pet.❤️

Dear Dale,

Thanks for your review. 

Kind regards,
The team at Wolfe Vets
As always, Wolfe comes through.  Minor issue but was worried--had an appointment within the hour and all is well now!  Wolfe Vets does preserve one's sanity!

Another big thank you to the wonderful team at Wolfe Vets Chiswick. I am so grateful for not only your expertise but also the level of care you give to Charlie. And me!
This concern and care runs through the whole surgery - from the receptionists to the nurses to the vets to the owner, James. It makes me feel so confident.
I have never experienced this in any of the many veterinary practices I have visited before coming to Chiswick.
Thank you for making such a difference.
Thank you Elettra for your review.
Great place for your pet care. Clean and organized. Very caring and supportive staff.

Stay away from this veterinary clinic – I absolutely do not recommend them.
The vets here are incompetent, extremely expensive, and clearly lack proper diagnostic skills. They seem to base their decisions on textbooks or even Google – it’s honestly laughable if it wasn’t so tragic.

They misdiagnosed my dog with skin allergies (which he never had in my home country), and he ultimately died in horrible pain from an undiagnosed muscle cancer. It broke my heart.

Now my other dog has to undergo a painful and costly surgery to remove her third eyelid — all because a vet here misdiagnosed her with scratching and gave her some eye drops. Unbelievable.

I lost one dog because of them, and another is now suffering due to their negligence.

If you want a vet who actually cares and won’t just empty your wallet or kill your pet through ignorance — go to Snoots! They offer dental care, neutering, x-rays, and more, all included in a £33 consultation.

Avoid Wolfe at all costs!

Alice helped us with our little cat Oreo with a very complex tail procedure. Our other vets in Sutton were awful and Alice at Wolfe Vets was a shining light throughout the process. A clear step above in every sense. If only I was based closer it would be my permanent vets!

We've been taking our cat to Wolfe Vet in Chiswick for regular health checks and dental cleanings since they opened. While I appreciate the hard work and dedication of the vets, nurses, and all the staff, I’ve had some ongoing concerns about the quality of service.

There have been repeated administrative errors, and on two separate occasions, different vets prescribed a shampoo that is not suitable for cats. These issues have made me question the reliability of their internal systems and communication.

I do trust in the team’s care for animals, and I value their expertise, but there is definitely room for improvement in consistency and attention to detail.
I wish I could still rely on Wolfe Vet for my cat’s health with full confidence.

Would not trust another vet to take care and monitor my beloved Chutney , a 14 year old female Cavapoo.  We know we have limited time together but I feel heard and know that she’s got the best care until time is up.  Dr James is awesome.

Really nice staff and great looking clinic.

Dr Alice has been exceptional with our dog throughout her life, always honest and not pushy for any treatment that isn't necessary.

Very accommodating and non- judgemental. Would highly recommend.

We welcomed our sweet Truffle into our lives just this past May. She was only three months old when she had a terrible fall that left her with a severe fracture. It was heartbreaking to see her in pain, and we were told surgery was the only way she’d be able to walk properly again. Thanks to the incredible care and compassion of the entire team—and a very special thank you to James, whose dedication made all the difference—our little girl is now back to being a happy, playful, and healthy kitten. We’re beyond grateful. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

Veronica and Edoardo

Great vets office in Chiswick. Have been taking my dog there since I got him and have had lots of good experiences with the staff. He needed surgery recently to fix an aural hematoma and the only downside was the price. Even after the Wolfe Pack 10% discount it still came out to £1500.

Regardless of the cost he was very well taken care of and I was briefed on every step, and he loves going back. Lovely staff and facilities.
Thanks Philip.

The Gold Standard in Veterinary Care—Compassionate & Cutting-Edge!

For years, I’ve entrusted Wolfe Vets with my dog’s health, and they’ve exceeded every expectation. Not only is their team warm, knowledgeable, and deeply caring, but they also boast **state-of-the-art equipment** for diagnostics, from bloodwork to imaging. Whether it’s a routine check-up or a complex health concern, I’m confident they have the tools and expertise to pinpoint issues accurately and quickly.

What truly sets them apart is their combination of skill and kindness. Whether it was a routine check-up or an unexpected health concern, they treated my furry family member with the utmost care and professionalism. The facility is clean, modern, and well-equipped, making every visit stress-free.

It’s clear that this team doesn’t just see animals as patients—they treat them like family. Thank you for years of outstanding service and peace of mind. My dog is healthier and happier because of you!
Always look after our dogs well. Not stuck up like most of the vets in the area.
I've been going here since they opened; they look after my dogs and rabbits beautifully and are great with difficult breeds like dachshunds.

Dr. Dulcie did an absolutely amazing job! My cat Pixie had to get 8 teeth removed today (poor thing!), and I honestly couldn’t have asked for better care. Dr. Dulcie even came to our home beforehand, which made everything way less stressful for both me and Pixie. She was super kind, explained everything clearly, and you can just tell she really cares. The whole team was lovely and gentle, and I felt totally comfortable leaving Pixie with them. She’s now back home, snuggled up and recovering well. Huge thanks to Dr. Dulcie and everyone at Wolfe Vets — you’re the best!

Millie, our Cocker Spaniel (16yrs),  has been so well looked after by Wolfe Vets over the years, they are the best vets we’ve had over 25yrs+ of dog ownership, + can highly recommend them so thank you  Wolfe.

Wolf Vets Chiswick saved my best friend’s life!

I can’t say enough good things about the staff! I was not even registered with them but in my emergency situation only Wolf Vets accepted me when all others said no. From the consultation to the operation itself everything was clear no hidden fees. the receptionists, nurses and veterinarians. I would just like to say thank you from the bottom of my heart. Tanner is doing well now and my stress levels how been going down since then. Thanks you also for calling me up to check that we well. I thought I left something behind at first lol

Great clinic! My Boston Terrier and I have been served here for a year and are completely satisfied. I signed up for a subscription to my Memphis, and once every few months, we come for medicines for parasites or just for an inspection. They have an app for online appointments and observing the pet’s health history. So far, everything is fine. Thank you very much!

Excellent clinic and top class service.

I wish to share my personal experience of Wolfes Vets in Chiswick.I own two dogs one of which has had issues with her anal glands since 8 weeks old and is now 7.The other from time to time needs her done as well. …
